extracted.intended_audience: small business applicants preparing NIH SBIR/STTR (Phase I/II) grant applications (PA-16-302)
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling the Research & Related budget, budget justification, biosketches, current/pending support, and SBIR/STTR certification questions for an NIH SBIR Phase II (PA-16-302) application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section A: Senior/Key Person (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: A. Senior/Key Person — fields include Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each senior/key person with the specified fields. Include total funds requested for all Senior Key Persons in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section B: Other Personnel (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: B. Other Personnel — specify Number of Personnel, Project Role, Calendar Months, Academic Months, Summer Months, Requested Salary ($), Fringe Benefits, Funds Requested ($) for postdocs, graduate students, undergraduate students, secretarial/clerical, and named technicians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the total number of other personnel and total salary, wages and fringe benefits (A+B). Include named other personnel (e.g., Laura Hammer, Julianny Perez) with percent effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section C: Equipment (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: C. Equipment — Description: List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000. Equipment Item + Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each equipment item costing more than $5,000 and include total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section D: Travel (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Travel — Funds Requested ($) broken down into Domestic Travel Costs (Incl. Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs; report Total Travel Cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide estimated domestic and foreign travel costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: E. Participant/Trainee Support Costs — Funds Requested ($) for Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other; Number of Participants/Trainees; Total Participant Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicable, itemize trainee support costs and report number of participants/trainees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section F: Other Direct Costs (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: F. Other Direct Costs — Funds Requested ($) for 1. Materials and Supplies, 2. Publication Costs, 3. Consultant Services, 4. ADP/Computer Services, 5. Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, 6. Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, 7. Alterations and Renovations, plus any other specified other costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize and justify other direct costs; include subcontract costs and consultants here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section G: Direct Costs (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: G. Direct Costs — Funds Requested ($) Total Direct Costs (A thru F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sum Sections A through F to report total direct costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section H: Indirect Costs (Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: H. Indirect Costs — Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the indirect cost rate (e.g., overhead 40.00%), base, total indirect costs, and provide Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: I. Total Direct and Indirect Costs — Funds Requested ($) Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the combined total of direct and indirect costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section J: Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: J. Fee — Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicable, report fee amount requested (program/agency-specific rules may apply).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section K: Budget Justification (single attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: K. Budget Justification — File attachment required; only attach one file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a detailed narrative justification for personnel, percent effort, materials and supplies, animal costs, equipment purchases, subcontracting, consultant fees, and other budget items. The form states 'File Name: 1234-BudgetJustificationVaccinePhase II.pdf' and 'Only attach one file.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel justification and percent effort
rubrics_metrics.description: The justification for each individual and their proposed percent effort is shown below in the Budget Justification (personnel descriptions for PI, Co-PI, senior scientist, consultants, technicians, operations director etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain why the number of personnel and proposed effort are needed to complete studies. For each named person include experience, specific responsibilities, and percent effort (e.g., Yingru Liu 50% Year 1/Year 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment purchase threshold and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment purchases — request funds to purchase items exceeding threshold (example: replacement cell culture hood at cost $6,872.62).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If acquiring equipment, list cost and justification (e.g., replacement of aging hood). Items > $5,000 must be listed in Section C.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animals, materials and supplies justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Animals, Materials and Supplies — list required consumables (recombinant IL-12, microparticle polymer, HPLC columns, β-Estradiol, Ceftriaxone, culture materials, antibodies, ELISA kits, mice) and provide detailed breakdown of expenses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide counts and per-item costs; include vertebrate animal per diem charges and point to the vertebrate animal section for justification of numbers of animals used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animal per diem and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Per diem charges for BSL2 mice housed in Micro-isolator cages are $0.58 per mouse per day as per agreement with Division of Comparative Medicine Laboratory Animal Facilities; 'Please see the vertebrate animal section for the justification for the numbers of mice used.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include per diem calculations and refer to the vertebrate animal section for scientific justification; include subcontracted animal toxicology costs when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subcontracting and Consortium reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs under Other Direct Costs and indicate if the application includes subcontracts with Federal laboratories or other Federal agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If subcontracts exist, include names of federal labs/agencies; list subcontracted toxicology and reproductive toxicology costs (examples: Comparative Biosciences).

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR Program Type and Phase selection
rubrics_metrics.description: Program Type — select only one: SBIR, STTR, or Both. SBIR/STTR Type — select only one: Phase I, Phase II, Fast-Track.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow agency-specific instructions to determine allowed selections; the form shows '●SBIR' and '●Phase II' for this application.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR question set (Questions 1–7 must be completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions 1–7 must be completed by all SBIR and STTR Applicants and include: 1a. Certification that at time of award organization will meet small business eligibility criteria; 1b. Anticipated Number of personnel to be employed at time of award; 2. Whether application includes subcontracts with Federal labs; 3. HUBZone status; 4. Will all R&D be performed in the United States; 5. Prior submissions/awards for essentially equivalent work; 6. Disclosure Permission Statement for non-awarded applications; 7. Commercialization Plan required for Phase II or Fast-Track.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer each question and attach supporting files where required (e.g., commercialization plan). For question 4, if 'No', provide an explanation in an attached file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization Plan requirement for Phase II
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 7: If you are submitting a Phase II or Phase I/Phase II Fast-Track Application, include a Commercialization Plan in accordance with the agency announcement and/or agency-specific instructions. Attach File.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the commercialization plan file (example: '1259-Commercalization Plan GC FINAL.pdf'). Phase II applications must include this plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR-specific question on prior Phase II awards and commercialization history
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 8 (SBIR-specific): Have you received SBIR Phase II awards from the Federal Government? If yes, provide a company commercialization history in accordance with agency-specific instructions using an attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, attach a commercialization statement (example: '1260-COMMERCIALIZATION STATEMENT.pdf').

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR-specific PD/PI employment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 9 (SBIR-specific): Will the Project Director/Principal Investigator have his/her primary employment with the small business at the time of award? (Yes/No)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For SBIR applications, the PD/PI is typically required to have primary employment at the small business at award time; answer and document accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR PD/PI appointment and effort requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 10 (STTR-specific): Indicate whether BOTH are TRUE: (1) PD/PI has a formal appointment or commitment with the small business OR as an employee of the Research Institution which has made a commitment to the small business; AND (2) PD/PI will devote at least 10% effort to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For STTR, PD/PI appointment and minimum percent effort requirements must be met; answer Yes/No as instructed.

rubrics_metrics.name: STTR work share requirement (small business vs research institution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Question 11 (STTR-specific): In the joint research and development proposed, will the small business perform at least 40% of the work and the research institution perform at least 30% of the work?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: STTR applications must meet the required distribution of work (small business ≥40%, research institution ≥30%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form-level administrative data requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative fields required on the Research & Related budget: OMB Number, Expiration Date, Tracking Number, Funding Opportunity Number, Received Date, Organizational DUNS, Budget Type (Project or Subaward/Consortium), Organization name, Start/End Dates, Budget Period number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete administrative metadata accurately for submission (example values shown: Funding Opportunity Number PA-16-302; Tracking Number GRANT12235571).

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment naming and file-type conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget Justification and other supporting documents must be attached as files with a file name and Mime Type; only one file allowed for Budget Justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the form's instruction on attachments (e.g., 'File Name: 1234-BudgetJustificationVaccinePhase II.pdf', Mime Type: application/pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cognizant Federal Agency information for indirect costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Cognizant Federal Agency (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number) when reporting indirect costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the agency that negotiates or recognizes your indirect cost rate to support claimed indirect costs.
